description: Generate a meme from a text prompt. Picks the best template and writes captions automatically using a frontier LLM. Best when you have an idea but not a specific template in mind. Returns a CDN URL for the rendered meme. Costs 2 credits per meme.

count.description: Number of meme variations to generate (1-3). Default 1.

text.description: The idea, joke, or situation to memify.

tone.description: Optional tone hint. One of: funny, sarcastic, wholesome, dark, corporate, gen_z.

watermark.description: Optional brand watermark (Starter+ plans only). Provide either "text" OR "logo_url". Defaults: bottom-right, 65% opacity, white-on-dark text legible on any background.

logo_url.description: Public URL of a logo image to stamp instead of text.

scale.description: Logo width as a fraction of image width (logo mode).

name: createa_meme_generate
